subject: Orchid Health: tailored log retention & legal-hold overlap — evidence and timeline
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@orchid-health.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Mercado <daniel@orchid-health.com>, Orchid Health Legal <legal@orchid-health.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Data retention window overlap / legal hold for Orchid Health account

Hi Chloe,

Quick one — our legal team has an interim subpoena that requires preservation of session and inference logs going back 12 months for a limited tenant subset (three customer IDs) while we complete an investigation. Orchid's standard requirement in the contract is 90 days for session/index logs, but this hold would overlap and temporarily extend retention for those three tenants only.

Can Redwood provide:
- A short technical description of where tenant-scoped inference/session logs are stored (hot vs. warm tier) and whether we can pull a 12-month range export for just those tenant IDs?
- Evidence or controls mapping to SOC 2 / SIG control IDs that describe log retention, extraction, and proof-of-delete processes (we want a checklist to share with in-house counsel).
- Any costs / timeline for producing the slice and for maintaining the temporary retention beyond the standard 90 days.

We can share the formal request via DocuSign if that helps. Please advise on next steps — we need a preliminary answer within 3 business days.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of Privacy & Legal
Orchid Health

Chloe

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Data retention window overlap / legal hold for Orchid Health account

Chloe — summary below after a quick sync with infra: 

1) Storage and retrieval:
- Tenant-scoped inference/session logs are stored initially in the hot layer (LSM-backed object store) for 60 days, then transition to warm archive for incremental 12 months, then to cold snapshots after 365 days by default.
- For the three tenant IDs we can produce a scoped export covering the past 12 months. Export will be a filtered Parquet/CSV bundle referencing request IDs, timestamps, and KV-cache lookup events. Estimated raw size: ~85GB.
- Export path: one-time export delivered to a secure S3 bucket (customer-owned or Redwood pre-signed transfer).

2) Feasibility and timeline:
- One-time export: 5–7 business days to coordinate (access approvals, infra job, staging, and validation).
- If they want to keep logs retained (i.e., suspend automated deletions) instead of a one-off export, we can apply a tenant-scoped retention override for up to 180 days. Longer holds require a support ticket + approval from product/reliability.

3) Technical caveats:
- We can stop automatic deletion for the specified tenant IDs, but we do not currently provide an indefinite tenant-level hold longer than 180 days without a formal exception and capacity planning.
- Index-level artifacts (fast lookup indices) may not be retained in warm tier beyond 120 days; exported data will include raw events but re-hydration of indices for fast forensic queries may need re-indexing ops.

I'll attach a CSV map showing which tables/files the export includes.

Priyom
Senior SRE, Data Processing
Redwood Inference

--- Attachment stub: redwood-log-map.csv (columns: path,table,retention_tier,notes)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Data retention window overlap / legal hold for Orchid Health account

Adding cost/ops note: 

- One-time export (85GB): nominal data-export cost + 8–12 engineer-hours for coordination and validation. Ballpark quote: $1,800–$2,800 depending on whether we use customer S3 or Redwood transfer.
- Tenant-scoped retention override (up to 180 days): operational cost is mostly ongoing storage delta (~$0.10/GB/month x retained bytes) + a small runbook overhead; recommend $300/mo minimum.
- If Orchid requires >180 days retention, we need a Capacity Approval and an SLA addendum. That path typically adds a 6–8 week schedule for product sign-off.

Operational impact: overriding retention suspends cleanup jobs for the tenant IDs; we need to tag the tenant in our retention index and ensure the proof-of-delete process is disabled for those keys until the hold is released. That also means retention/extraction audit logs must be preserved (we can provide those as part of the evidence pack).

Rishi
Director, Infrastructure Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@orchid-health.com>, Daniel Mercado <daniel@orchid-health.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Jul 2028 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Data retention window overlap / legal hold for Orchid Health account

Elena — thanks for the clear ask. Below is a proposed mutual action plan and immediate deliverables; attaching a short MA plan PDF and a spreadsheet mapping SOC2/SIG/CAIQ artifacts.

Proposed interim plan (summary):
1) We will run a tenant-scoped 12-month export for the three tenant IDs and deliver to a secure bucket. Timeline: 5–7 business days after we receive the signed hold request (DocuSign).
2) If you prefer we maintain the logs live instead of export, we can apply a tenant-scoped retention override for up to 180 days. Redwood will log the override event and preserve audit trails.
3) Evidence we will provide with the export: export manifest (CSV), ingestion/retention control mapping (SOC 2 control IDs), proof-of-disable for automatic deletion for the tagged tenant IDs, and a snapshot hash manifest to prove integrity of exported files.

Costs: one-time export estimate $2,200 (engineer time + transfer). Optional retention override: $300/mo for storage/ops monitoring. If you request >180 days, we'll need a formal exception (capacity & legal), which typically requires 6+ weeks.

Attachments: proposed-ma-plan.pdf, orchid-soc2-evidence-request.xlsx (control mapping).

Please send the formal DocuSign request and we will create a ticket and schedule the export job.

Regards,
Chloe Martin
Manager, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
